definitions.documentation:
POST /v2/checkout/orders. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CREATE-ORDER". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

POST /v2/checkout/orders/{orderId}/capture. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CAPTURE-ORDER". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

environment.description: Required fixed API environment; no default and no arbitrary hosts.

definitions.description: PayPal Authorize Order
definitions.documentation:
POST /v2/checkout/orders/{orderId}/authorize. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL AUTHORIZE-ORDER". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
GET /v2/payments/authorizations/{paymentId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
GET /v2/payments/captures/{paymentId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
GET /v2/payments/refunds/{paymentId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.description: PayPal Capture Authorization
definitions.documentation:
POST /v2/payments/authorizations/{paymentId}/capture. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CAPTURE-AUTHORIZATION". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
POST /v2/payments/authorizations/{paymentId}/reauthorize. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL REAUTHORIZE-PAYMENT". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: PayPal Void Authorization
definitions.documentation:
POST /v2/payments/authorizations/{paymentId}/void. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL VOID-AUTHORIZATION". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: PayPal Refund Capture
definitions.documentation:
POST /v2/payments/captures/{paymentId}/refund. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL REFUND-CAPTURE". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
GET /v1/catalogs/products. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
GET /v1/billing/plans. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
GET /v1/billing/plans/{planId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

POST /v1/billing/plans. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CREATE-PLAN". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
POST /v1/billing/plans/{planId}/activate. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL ACTIVATE-PLAN". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.description: PayPal deactivate Plan
definitions.documentation:
POST /v1/billing/plans/{planId}/deactivate. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL DEACTIVATE-PLAN". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
GET /v1/billing/subscriptions. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

GET /v1/billing/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. definitions.documentation:
POST /v1/billing/subscriptions. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CREATE-SUBSCRIPTION". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

POST /v1/billing/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/revise. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL REVISE-SUBSCRIPTION". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
POST /v1/billing/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/activate. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL ACTIVATE-SUBSCRIPTION". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
POST /v1/billing/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/capture. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CAPTURE-SUBSCRIPTION". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
GET /v1/billing/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/transactions. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

GET /v2/invoicing/invoices. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. GET /v2/invoicing/invoices/{invoiceId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

POST /v2/invoicing/invoices. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CREATE-INVOICE". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

definitions.documentation:
PUT /v2/invoicing/invoices/{invoiceId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL UPDATE-INVOICE". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

DELETE /v2/invoicing/invoices/{invoiceId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL DELETE-INVOICE". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

POST /v2/invoicing/invoices/{invoiceId}/send. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL SEND-INVOICE". No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

POST /v1/payments/payouts. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. Mutation requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="PAYPAL CREATE-PAYOUT". Required requestId is sent as PayPal-Request-Id; reuse only for the identical operation and payload within this endpoint's provider retention window. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

GET /v1/payments/payouts/{payoutId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. GET /v1/customer/disputes. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. definitions.documentation:
GET /v1/customer/disputes/{disputeId}. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

GET /v1/reporting/transactions. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/

GET /v1/reporting/balances. Explicit sandbox/live environment; external OAuth bearer in RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN/explicit tokenSecret. No PayPal-Request-Id support is assumed for this endpoint. All present $retries must be numeric zero. No automatic retries, OAuth/account actions, approval UI, card data, arbitrary routes, pagination following, provider URL following, listeners or credential refresh. Known bounded response projection omits unsupported fields. Decimal money strings preserve exact value. One request, 512 KiB request, 1 MiB response, 16384 nonempty chunks, depth 35, 100 rows per explicit page. Total 100–30000 ms deadline begins before profile/secret access and guards final output. External capabilities/scopes, business approval and provider state rules apply. Sources: https://developer.paypal.com/api/orders/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/catalog-products/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/subscriptions/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/invoicing/v2 https://developer.paypal.com/api/payments.payouts-batch/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/customer-disputes/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1 https://developer.paypal.com/api/rest/reference/idempotency/
